Downward Lookup Compilation

How to run giant coding models inside tiny laptop memory and turn verified answers into millisecond reflexes.

[970 MB Active RAM · 91.7% Verified · 0% Broken]

1/3 Most requests repeat solved patterns, so running a giant neural network every time wastes memory and energy.

2/3 This cascade checks tiny truth tables first and streams specialist model slices from storage only when needed.

3/3 Once an automated test certifies a new answer, it compiles downward into a reusable millisecond skill.
